name: iobroker.intercom
description: Asterisk PBX with WebRTC in Docker, configured completely from ioBroker admin
author: bluefox <dogafox@gmail.com>

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build:www && npm run build:widgets && npm run build:devices
scripts.check:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd src-www && npm run check:ts && cd ../src-widgets && npm run check:ts && cd ../src-devices && npm run check:ts
scripts.lint: eslint -c eslint.config.mjs && cd src-www && npm run lint && cd ../src-widgets && npm run lint && cd ../src-devices && npm run lint && cd ../src-shared && eslint -c eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:package
scripts.update-packages: npx -y npm-check-updates --upgrade && cd src-www && npx -y npm-check-updates --upgrade && cd ../src-widgets && npx -y npm-check-updates --upgrade && cd ../src-devices && npx -y npm-check-updates --upgrade
scripts.npm: npm i && cd src-www && npm i && cd ../src-widgets && npm i && cd ../src-devices && npm i
scripts.build:www: cd src-www && npm run build && cd .. && node tasks.mts --www
scripts.build:widgets: cd src-widgets && npm run build && cd .. && node tasks.mts --widgets
scripts.build:devices: cd src-devices && npm run build && cd .. && node tasks.mts --devices
